description: This file defines the AdmonitionRenderer class, which implements the NodeRendererInterface for rendering admonition blocks in Markdown using the League CommonMark library. It provides a render method that generates HTML for admonition UI components, including titles and children nodes.

classes.name: AdmonitionRenderer
classes.description: Implements the NodeRendererInterface to render admonition blocks with custom HTML, handling titles and children nodes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an admonition block into HTML, adding title if available and applying appropriate classes.
